source.quote: This document contains Gmail API-specific authorization and authentication information.

oauthAppCreation.where: Google Cloud console, Google Auth platform: Branding, Audience and Data Access for the consent screen, then Clients for the OAuth client ID

reviewGate.trigger: Restricted scopes (gmail.readonly, gmail.modify, gmail.compose, mail.google.com) need OAuth verification plus an annual third-party security assessment when data is stored on a server. Sensitive scopes (gmail.send) need verification only.

source.quote: Every app that requests access to Google users' restricted data and has the ability to access data from or through a third-party server must go through a security assessment from Google-empanelled security assessors.

approvalWait.stated: Restricted scope verification: 6 weeks. Sensitive scope verification: 10 business days. Brand verification: 2-3 business days. Estimates are not guaranteed.

source.quote: An additional Security assessment is required to demonstrate a minimum level of capability in handling data securely and deleting user data upon user request. 6 weeks

moreSources.quote: The sensitive scope verification process can take up to 10 days to complete.
the restricted scopes verification process can potentially take several weeks to complete

testBeforeApproval.how: Keep the consent screen in Testing status: up to 100 listed test users, authorizations expire after 7 days

source.quote: Projects configured with a publishing status of Testing are limited to up to 100 test users listed in the OAuth consent screen.

offSurface.why: Real strings, but only for Google Workspace add-ons, not for a standalone Gmail API app

source.quote: View your email message metadata when the add-on is running.
https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly View your email messages and settings.
https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify Read, compose, and send emails from your Gmail account.
https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.labels See and edit your email labels.
https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.metadata View your email message metadata such as labels and headers, but not the email body.

blockers.summary: Restricted Gmail scopes need an annual security assessment by a Google-approved third-party assessor

source.quote: must undergo an annual security assessment from an independent, third-party assessor that is approved by Google

blockers.summary: A public app using sensitive or restricted scopes must pass OAuth verification, or users see an unverified app screen

source.quote: If your public application uses scopes that permit access to certain user data, it must complete a verification process.

blockers.summary: Brand verification comes first for every app and takes 2-3 business days

source.quote: all apps must complete the brand verification step first, which typically takes 2-3 business days

blockers.summary: In Testing status, test-user authorizations and refresh tokens expire after seven days

source.quote: Authorizations by a test user will expire seven days from the time of consent.

avoidProducts.name: Contact Center AI Platform
avoidProducts.why: A different Google product with its own Gmail OAuth setup page
avoidProducts.evidence: Stored gmail guide cited it in 11 of 39 claims (docs/walkthrough/08b-trust-real-cases.md, case 1)

avoidProducts.name: Google Workspace add-ons
avoidProducts.why: Add-on scopes are not what a standalone Gmail API app requests
avoidProducts.evidence: Stored gmail guide listed add-on scope descriptions as its scopes (08b, case 2)

notes: Review gate depends on the scopes: sensitive-only apps stop at verification (required_to_scale), restricted-scope apps that store data on servers need the security assessment. The golden value is the restricted path because reading mail is the common agent use.
The sensitive-scope page says 10 days and the FAQ table says 10 business days. Both are recorded.
